nodes.name: Chain Orchestrator Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph benchmark node (BENCH-006) documenting the end-to-end deterministic replay harness for the Chain Orchestrator, asserting byte-identical replay across all five record types plus admission idempotency via a pinned golden artifact (chain_bench.json).
nodes.languageNotes: dev_graph benchmark_result ontology node; relationship subsections (Depends On / Validated By / Justified By) use wikilinks to Chain Orchestrator, runtime/portfolio schemas, and execution/paper-trading ADRs.

nodes.name: Execution Layer Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph benchmark node (BENCH-004) documenting the execution-layer replay harness that proves the ADR-011 execution-determinism invariant, combining a real ADMIT sequence with a synthetic sweep covering fill, no-fill, idempotency, and guard-BLOCK attribution.
nodes.languageNotes: dev_graph benchmark_result node; closing artifact for ADR-011 §7 gate (d); v0.2.0 runtime re-pin notes captured in Results.

nodes.name: Gold Decision Distribution Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph benchmark node (BENCH-002) documenting the Gold Decision Builder replay harness, providing determinism evidence over real snapshots plus a synthetic regime-grid sweep emitting the paper-decision direction distribution and confidence/uncertainty stats.
nodes.languageNotes: dev_graph benchmark_result node; pins a golden gold_bench.json artifact validated by test_gold_bench.

nodes.name: Gold Forward-Return Label Set.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph benchmark node (BENCH-005) documenting the committed forward-return label artifact produced by the Gold Forward-Return Labeler, the deferred-G3 calibration input that records per decision-by-horizon realized gold returns plus regime-by-horizon aggregates.
nodes.languageNotes: dev_graph benchmark_result node; measurement-only artifact constrained by Canonical Ownership, strictly downstream of the decision chain (labels must never reach a decision).

nodes.name: Paper-Trading Runtime Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph benchmark node (BENCH-003) documenting the paper-trading runtime replay harness that proves runtime determinism, idempotency, and no-enrich-back over a real sequence plus a synthetic verdict-space sweep (ADMIT/HOLD/REJECT attribution).
nodes.languageNotes: dev_graph benchmark_result node; documents the v0.2.0 computed-cooldown re-pin and pins a paper_runtime_bench.json golden artifact.

nodes.name: Regime Distribution Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph benchmark node (BENCH-001) documenting the first benchmark harness for the Market Regime Classifier, measuring real-snapshot replay determinism and synthetic feature-grid sweep coverage (all 11 regimes reachable, entropy, classification balance).
nodes.languageNotes: dev_graph benchmark_result node; originates from the Regime Taxonomy and pins a regime_bench.json golden artifact validated by test_regime_bench.
